description: Election Commission - J. D. L. A. S. Somarathna was selected as the member of the Kobeigane P/S - M. Benadict was selected as the member of the Kayts P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Kobeigane Pradeshiya Sabha and Kayts Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of selected members to fill positions that became vacant due to resignation or party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters at the local government level.
